title: Sparkly mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Phone body -->
  <rect x='30' y='14' width='40' height='72' rx='8' fill='#3f4fa8'/>
  <!-- Phone screen -->
  <rect x='35' y='22' width='30' height='52' rx='3' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
  <!-- Screen highlight / glow -->
  <rect x='37' y='24' width='10' height='12' rx='2' fill='#c8f7ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='3' fill='#8fa0e8'/>
  <!-- Speaker slot -->
  <rect x='44' y='17.5' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8fa0e8'/>
  <!-- Sparkle top-left -->
  <path d='M18 20 L20 26 L26 28 L20 30 L18 36 L16 30 L10 28 L16 26 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- Sparkle top-right -->
  <path d='M80 12 L81.5 17 L86.5 18.5 L81.5 20 L80 25 L78.5 20 L73.5 18.5 L78.5 17 Z' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- Sparkle bottom-right -->
  <path d='M84 62 L86 69 L93 71 L86 73 L84 80 L82 73 L75 71 L82 69 Z' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- Sparkle bottom-left small -->
  <path d='M14 66 L15.5 70 L19.5 71.5 L15.5 73 L14 77 L12.5 73 L8.5 71.5 L12.5 70 Z' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <!-- Sparkle mid-right small -->
  <path d='M74 44 L75.2 47.5 L78.7 48.7 L75.2 49.9 L74 53.4 L72.8 49.9 L69.3 48.7 L72.8 47.5 Z' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- Star dots -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='44' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='34' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='86' r='1.6' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='86' r='1.6' fill='#ffd24d'/>
</svg>
